prompt:
Write a client review left on a freelance platform for Noor Halden after this project.

Project facts (the only truth you may use):
title: Grocery demand forecasting
client: Marrow & Pine Grocers
client_industry: retail
start: 2021-04
end: 2021-08
engagement: hourly
stack:
- Python
- LightGBM
- Prophet
- Airflow
- BigQuery
implied_skills:
- hierarchical forecasting
built: Weekly store-by-SKU forecasts for 420 SKUs across 31 stores, scheduled in Airflow
  and written back to BigQuery.
metrics:
- WAPE from 31% to 19%
- spoilage write-offs down 11% in the pilot stores

The review is from: Marrow & Pine Grocers
Rating: 3.5 out of 5

Requirements:
- 2 to 5 sentences in the voice of a busy client, not a marketer.
- If the rating is below 4.5, include one honest complaint (communication, delays or scope).
- Only mention results that appear in the facts. Never use: "hierarchical forecasting".
text: Noor helped us build weekly store-by-SKU forecasts for 420 SKUs across 31 stores, with the outputs scheduled in Airflow and written back to BigQuery. The work did improve our WAPE from 31% to 19%, and spoilage write-offs were down 11% in the pilot stores. That said, there were some communication and scope alignment issues along the way, which made the project take more back-and-forth than we expected.
